summary: Blocks any tool call that would spend a paid Anthropic or OpenAI API key outside a paying customer's request, such as a test, eval, demo or CI job.
doc: This hook denies a tool call that would spend a paid Anthropic or OpenAI API key: an HTTP call to a spending endpoint (messages, chat completions, responses, embeddings, batches and similar), a POST with a body to either API host, an SDK spending method run inline from a shell, and a spending call written into a test, fixture, eval, smoke, demo, CI, script or scheduled-job path. A billed token cannot be refunded and the call does not fail, so the tool call is the only place to stop it. GET /v1/models, reading an error body, editing a product's inference driver, the Gemini free tier, a model on localhost and a subscription CLI in print mode are all allowed. To quote a spending command on purpose in a file, put it in a fenced code block, an inline backtick span, an indented block or a '>' blockquote. A Bash command or a fetched URL is never treated as a quotation.
